beat: Dhika asks about E09 kiss reaction; Chotu's insecurity, painting clothes and safer stool choice

lines.original: Giggling... she went into the kitchen and brought him a glass a of water... while Chotu gulped it down, she sat next to him with something on her mind and she felt like she immediately wanted to ask him about it..... It was troubling her for long............. and without knowing how to start.....
lines.local: Hanste hue Dhika kitchen se Chotu ke liye paani lekar aayi. Chotu ne paani piya; paas baithi Dhika ke dimaag mein kaafi dino se ek sawaal tha, jo woh abhi poochhna chahti thi, par samajh nahi aa raha tha kaise shuru kare.

lines.original: Dhika: I....uh...no....I mean......last time.... when I kissed you... you kinda smiled and ran away......
lines.local: Dhika: Main... uh... nahi, mera matlab... pichhli baar jab maine tumhe kiss kiya, tum halka sa smile karke bhaag gaye the...

lines.original: Chotu: smiling and feeling shy...uhn... ya didi.... I ....
lines.local: Chotu sharmaakar muskuraya: Uhn... haan didi, main...

lines.original: Dhika: giggling... first I thought you ran away because I frightened you... but while you were going away, I saw you hopping and smiling... so,....... I take I did not hurt you ?
lines.local: Dhika hansi: Pehle laga maine tumhe dara diya. Lekin jaate hue tumhe uchhalte aur hanste dekha, toh samjhun ki maine tumhe hurt nahi kiya?

lines.original: Chotu: hurt... no no didi.. in fact.... I felt a little sad, only because......
lines.local: Chotu: Hurt? Nahi-nahi didi. Darasal main thoda udaas tha, sirf isliye kyunki...

lines.original: Dhika: because ?,.....she looked at him curiously from side glance....
lines.local: Dhika ne side se curious nazar daali: Kyunki?

lines.original: Chotu: Because.....you kissed me better than I you... he said quickly and feeling embarrassed, put this head down....
lines.local: Chotu ne jaldi se kaha: Kyunki aapne mujhe jitna achha kiss kiya, main aapko utna achha nahi kar paaya. Kehkar sharm se sir jhuka liya.

lines.original: Dhika: .........hahahahahahahahahaha Chotu, it wasn't like that.
Chotu: go didi.. don't laugh now... please
lines.local: Chotu: Jaao didi, ab mat hanso please.

lines.original: She didn't know what else to say. Yes, his kiss was very clumsy and immature. Dhika is not an expert herself, but atleast she has gained a little experience from John...
lines.local: Dhika ko aur kya kahe samajh nahi aaya. Haan, Chotu ka kiss kaafi clumsy aur inexperienced tha; woh khud expert nahi thi, par John ke saath thoda experience mila tha.

lines.original: Chotu just sat there feeling embarrassed and sad for himself....
lines.local: Chotu wahin baitha, apni baat par embarrassed aur udaas mehsoos karta raha.

lines.original: Chotu: don't laugh didi... please.. I know it was bad..
lines.local: Chotu: Mat hanso didi, please. Mujhe pata hai achha nahi tha.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe...I am not laughing for that...anyway hehe... ok ok I won't laugh....
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, main us baat par nahi hans rahi... achha-achha, ab nahi hasungi!

lines.original: After a few minutes of laughing and teasing him, Dhika went in and brought the dress which she bought for Chotu to wear while painting... Leaving Chotu to change the dress in the hall, Dhika moved into Pappu's room. ........
lines.local: Kuch minute teasing aur hansne ke baad Dhika Chotu ke liye kharide painting waale kapde laayi. Chotu hall mein kapde badalne laga aur Dhika Pappu ke room mein gayi.

lines.original: With Chotu spilling paint quite often, Dhika was determined not to let Chotu stand on the stool hereafter... So, today, she stood on the stool and started painting the upper portion.....
lines.local: Chotu aksar paint gira deta tha, isliye Dhika ne tay kiya ab use stool par nahi chadhaayegi. Aaj khud stool par khadi hokar deewar ka upper part paint karne lagi.
